title: Do Professional Rankings Affect Analyst Behavior? Evidence From a Regression Discontinuity Design
authors: Michael J. Jung; Yiqing Lü; Hong Wu; Yuhai Xuan
eligible_reason: Regression discontinuity design: rank_d = 1 for third-place Institutional Investor all-stars vs fourth-place runners-up within a bandwidth of the composite-score difference (score_diff_rank3_sec_yr), reghdfe y rank_d $controls if (rank3 == 3 | rank3 == 4) & within bandwidth, absorb(cusip yq). No difference-in-differences or staggered adoption design.
design_notes: Analyst-firm-quarter outcomes (forecast optimism, recommendation optimism, market reactions, conference-call priority, promotions) after annual October II rankings 2001-2014, comparing barely-winning third-place analysts to barely-losing fourth-place analysts.
data_files_note: readme.pdf: proprietary II ranking data shipped with analyst and company IDs reshuffled for confidentiality; licensed IBES/CRSP/Compustat-derived analysis variables included in the table datasets.
data_provenance_note: Values as used in the paper; analyst and company identifiers reshuffled (masked).
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). RDD paper; prescore 2 reflects reghdfe with FE.
